faqs.a: Yes. B’s Wax is fully mobile. We serve Sugar Land, Missouri City, Stafford, Richmond, Rosenberg, Katy, Pearland and surrounding areas.

faqs.q: How much does an interior detail cost?
faqs.a: The Sweet Refresh starts at $95, The Golden Reset at $155 and B’s Wax Signature at $225. Final pricing varies by vehicle size and condition. Severely soiled interiors require a quote.

faqs.q: Can I add extra care to my package?
faqs.a: Yes. Options include heavy pet hair removal, additional stain or odor treatment, child car seat cleaning, trunk or cargo deep cleaning, and headliner spot treatment. Final add-on pricing depends on condition and labor needed.

View available appointment times in Koalendar, choose your service and share your vehicle details. Final pricing is based on vehicle size and condition, and photos may be requested if needed. You can also send a request through this website.

faqs.q: How can I ask a question before booking?
faqs.a: Text B’s Wax at 346-246-2358 or message @bwax.autospa on Instagram.
